description: Defines the BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl class, a QUIC-based implementation of a bidirectional stream in the Chromium networking code. Contains class declaration, member functions, and private data members related to QUIC stream handling.

classes.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl
classes.description: A class implementing a bidirectional stream over QUIC, inheriting from BidirectionalStreamImpl. Manages stream lifecycle, headers, data transfer, and error handling.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the QUIC bidirectional stream with request info, logging, delegate, timer, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends the request headers over the stream.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into the provided buffer.

methods.name: SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers of data over the stream, with optional end_stream flag.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Populates load timing info for the stream.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details.

methods.name: WriteHeaders
methods.description: Handles writing headers to the stream.

methods.name: OnStreamReady
methods.description: Callback when stream is ready.

methods.name: OnSendDataComplete
methods.description: Callback when data sending completes.

methods.name: ReadInitialHeaders
methods.description: Reads initial headers from the stream.

methods.name: OnReadInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Callback when initial headers are read.

methods.name: ReadTrailingHeaders
methods.description: Reads trailing headers.

methods.name: OnReadTrailingHeadersComplete
methods.description: Callback when trailing headers are read.

methods.name: OnReadDataComplete
methods.description: Callback when data read is complete.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Notifies delegate of an error and cleans up.

methods.name: NotifyErrorImpl
methods.description: Handles asynchronous or synchronous error notification.

methods.name: NotifyStreamReady
methods.description: Notifies delegate that stream is ready.

methods.name: ResetStream
methods.description: Resets the stream and prevents delegate callbacks.

methods.name: NotifyFailure
methods.description: Invokes failure notification on delegate.
